title: Internal memo: ICE bars its employees from wearing Meta's AI glasses, saying they "could unintentionally capture, record, or transmit sensitive information" (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: Internal memo: ICE bars its employees from wearing Meta's AI glasses, saying they “could unintentionally capture, record, or transmit sensitive information” — The agency joins a growing number of workplaces and groups to ban Meta's devices, which have spurred privacy concerns.
